verdict: Paid campaigns remain paused; organic reach is now fading without that support.
narrative: No paid spend ran in the last 28 days across Meta or Google, meaning zero paid leads were generated this period. Organic channels carried the load, but they are softening: Google Business Profile actions dropped 75% week-over-week, and search clicks fell 32% in the same span — both consistent with what happens when paid visibility is removed for an extended stretch. Three pending items — the engagement extension, SMS automation, and phone access — are overdue from August 31 and are the immediate priority to unblock before campaigns can restart. Once those are resolved, paid campaigns are set to relaunch with a retargeting audience, and the organic posting cadence will be reinforced to stabilize local search performance.

highlights.phrase: paid spend in the last 28 days — all current traffic is organic
Google Business Profile actions received this period (calls, web clicks)
drop in Google Business Profile engagement in the last 7 days vs. the prior 7

watch_item.issue: Organic visibility is declining week-over-week as the absence of paid campaigns removes the traffic floor that supports local search performance.
watch_item.fix: The engagement extension and automation access items are being finalized now so paid campaigns and the organic posting cadence can both go live by end of September.
